summary: Haystack Mountain near Seeley Lake, MT: a 1930s L-4 cab, now gone. The two lookout pages name different forests; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Cab gone. No source we read describes what, if anything, remains.

evidence.supports: about 30 miles northeast of Seeley Lake
Rex's page names the Flathead and Lewis & Clark National Forests
Forest Lookouts lists the Deerlodge National Forest with reference 21N-12W-9
Forest Lookouts marks the site as removed
FFLA Montana list: ground-type site, gone
evidence.quote: Haystack Mountain Flathead/Powell/ Lewis & Clark 47.59434 -113.14360 Ground Gone

evidence.supports: Rex's page covers the cabin's history and says nothing about remains

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Rex's page names the Flathead and Lewis & Clark National Forests; the Forest Lookouts page names the Deerlodge National Forest. The record keeps Deerlodge, which the Forest Lookouts page supports; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two lookout pages and the FFLA list. The only build date is the 1930s, with no removal date and no staffing. The agency conflict is unresolved; the record says Deerlodge. The FFLA list gives the type as Ground. Nothing found on what remains or on access.
